summary: Tested the certification Tests feature end to end: backend with pytest (13/13 pass after 2 small fixes) and frontend with Playwright as anonymous, student and admin users. Working: public catalog and filters, the CSA landing page (details, 6 domain weights, 3 samples with check/hint/explanations, FAQs, related, 'Sign in to buy'), student hub, practice mode, exam and certification modes, the identity gate, resume, multi-select, scenario panels, results page, admin test editor (fixed list and pool), creating, publishing and enrolling in a free test, question bank (filters, preview, TF create, edit to v2, versions and restore to v3, archive, CSV import, case study add) and analytics. Security holds: no 'correct', 'why' or hint fields in in-progress exam/cert attempts; check=true gives 400; hint gives 400; another user's attempt gives 404; admin routes give 403 to students. One functional bug is still open: in practice mode you cannot flag a question after 'Check answer'.

minor.issue: In practice mode, flagging a question after it was checked returns 409 'Answer already checked'. The flag is never saved (UI shows a 'not saved' toast and the Result 'Flagged' filter shows 0). Fix: when the qid is in checked, still apply the flagged add/pull but don't overwrite answers.
FIXED by me: regex special characters gave 500 (re.error). Now uses re.escape.

FIXED by me: the domain was not URL-encoded. Names containing '&' (3 of 6 CSA domains) were cut short in ?practice=, so practice would not preselect the domain and starting it failed with 'no questions'. Now uses urllib.parse.quote; preselect checked in the UI.
Returns 200 on an already-submitted practice attempt (no status check). Harmless.
A timed practice session uses the full exam length (180 min) even for a 20-question domain practice.
There is no hard delete for exams that have attempts, for questions (archive only) or for scenarios (no DELETE route). Test data can only be cleaned up in the DB.

ui_bugs.issue: The flag toggle after 'Check answer' shows as flagged locally, but saving fails with 'Answer already checked'. Same backend 409 as above.

integration_issues.issue: Domain-only practice attempts are excluded, so the chart says 'no attempts yet' even after several practice attempts (hub shows Attempts: 3). The message is misleading; suggest 'complete a full-length attempt to see a trend'.

issues: On mobile the buy card shows above the title and breadcrumb
Mobile header: the 'Dashboard' button overlaps the 'SOCProfessionals' logo text (existing header)
Bar chart x-axis labels are truncated ('Incidents, Events &...')

The sample CSV row uses domain 'Incidents Events & Logging' (no comma), which doesn't match the real CSA domain 'Incidents, Events & Logging'. Imported template questions create a stray domain. Quote the field in the CSV so the comma can stay.

action_items: Fix PUT /answer so a flag-only update works on checked practice questions (don't 409; only block answer changes)
Add a status check to the hint endpoint (optional)
Fix the CSV template domain name so it matches 'Incidents, Events & Logging'
Clearer empty-state text for the trend chart when only domain practices exist; fix '1 candidates' plural
Consider a practice-timed duration scaled to the question count
critical_code_review_comments: routes_exams.answer: the checked guard runs before the flag logic, which causes the flag bug
start(): there is no atomic guard against two concurrent certification starts (race could create 2 cert attempts). Consider a unique partial index on (exam_id, user_id, mode, status=in_progress)
Multi-select: the server doesn't limit an answer to `choose` options (the UI does). Not exploitable for score, because grading needs an exact set match
Landing samples include full answers and explanations, and those 3 questions are also in the fixed CSA exam set (intentional, but noted)
The student purchase of test:csa-v1 was NOT in db.purchases at test start, although the brief said it was granted. The testing agent added it (see seed_data_creation)

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 after fixes; 1 open minor bug found via extra script)

seed_data_creation: Inserted db.purchases {user_id:b9cafa42b8ca (student), product_id:'test:csa-v1', test:true, granted_by:'testing_agent'} because it was missing. Left in place so the student owns the CSA test. Student's CSA attempts now include several practice attempts and 1 certification attempt (FAIL, 1%, legal name 'TEST Demo Student'). The student has 2/3 cert attempts left and a 24h cooldown is active, so the next manual cert start is blocked until about Nov 21 07:30 UTC. The student also gained XP from these attempts. All test-created TEST_ exams (5), their attempts and enrollments, TEST_ questions (4 qids incl. the imported CSV template question) and the TEST_ scenario were deleted from the DB; bank back to 100.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_exams_engine.py -n 0. It creates TEST_ exams; its cleanup only unpublishes exams with attempts and archives questions, so purge them from the DB afterwards. CSA cert for the student is in cooldown; for cert-mode tests, create a free TEST_ certification exam (as the pytest does). Not tested: webcam identity mode, auto-submit at timeout (180 min; logic reviewed only), Razorpay checkout for the paid test, reviews posting UI.
